summary: Temporary drone-only restriction within five nautical miles of RAF Mildenhall, Suffolk, up to 1,200 feet.
text:
RESTRICTED AREA (TEMPORARY) INSTALLED FOR UAS ONLY (RAF 
MILDENHALL, SUFFOLK). WI 5NM RADIUS OF PSN 522142.96N 0002911.06E. 
PILOTS ARE FORBIDDEN TO FLY UAS WITHIN THE DESIGNATED AREA WITHOUT 
THE PERMISSION OF EMERGENCY CONTROLLING AUTHORITY: RAF LAKENHEATH 
ATC UNIT CTC TEL 01638-543610 OR EMAIL USAFE-UK.A3(AT)US.AF.MIL. 
RESTRICTION OF FLYING REGULATIONS MADE UNDER ARTICLE 239 OF AIR NAV 
ORDER 2016. AR-2026-10691/02.
